I had a terrible experience with Antonio’s Tile. I paid over $9,000 in labor to retile my whole shower, and the quality of work was completely unacceptable.

On the final day, the worker Tony literally stepped on the freshly laid floor tiles before the mortar fully dried, which caused cracked grout and uneven tiles (see pictures 1–3). They came back a few days later to “fix” it, but the tiles are still uneven and not completely level.

After the floor was fully dried (48 hours), I did a water test and found that the slope wasn't done correctly, leading to multiple areas of standing water (pictures 4) and he claimed "normal wetness". In addition, there were cracked tiles installed (picture 5) and cracked grout lines (pictures 6–8) throughout the shower. I tried to contact Tony multiple times via both text and phone call to have these issues fixed — no response, and my calls went straight to voicemail. Later, I found out they blocked my number. Imagine a business that blocks its customer right after taking final payment to avoid responsibility!

In the end, I had to hire another contractor to fix their mess and file a small claims court case to recover damages. If you care about quality and accountability, do NOT hire him. Save yourself the stress, time, and money. BTW, the "beautiful marble shower" photo they just posted for advertisement is actually my shower ( pictures 9-10 ) — but they only showed the wall tiles and left out the floor tile mess .
